tweet_summary: 'Syrian Girl' (566k followers) posts a video claiming the US 'just bombed' Cafe Downtism, a Tehran cafe employing autistic and Down syndrome workers, framing it as breaking news of a US strike on disabled workers.
why_note_decision: The video is misattributed: it shows the aftermath of a fire at the Tehran cafe (footage online from 3 Feb 2026), not a US/Israeli airstrike (which post-dated the footage). The 'US just bombed' framing is false and emotionally charged; a note giving the real cause and timeline is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that the video does NOT show a US (or US-Israeli) bombing — it shows the aftermath of a fire at the Tehran cafe, with the footage appearing online weeks BEFORE the relevant military escalation (early Feb 2026). Strong note cites a fact-check (Lead Stories / AP-Yahoo) or the cafe's own attribution. It must AVOID vague hedging; the key point is fire (not airstrike) and that the cafe is in Tehran, Iran. A note that only says 'unverified' without giving the fire cause/timeline is too weak. Do NOT accept the 'US bombed it' claim.
reference_note: The cafe is in Tehran, Iran, and the video shows local firefighters responding to a fire there, not a US bombing. https://www.middleeasteye.net/features/tehrans-little-secret-cafe-where-disability-no-barrier-talent https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/massive-fire-breaks-tehran-shopping-095502324.html

fact_check.claim_verdict: False: video shows aftermath of a fire at the Tehran cafe (footage from ~3 Feb 2026), not a US/Israeli airstrike.
fact_check.notes: Lead Stories / AP-Yahoo: the footage first appeared online 3 Feb 2026, shared by the cafe's own Instagram, showing fire damage — 25 days before the escalation. The cafe (Downtism, opened 2018, employs autistic/Down syndrome staff) is marked 'permanently closed' on Google Maps with comments citing fire, not a strike. AI media description ('fireman working on a fire scene', OCR 'TEHRAN FIGHTER' i.e. firefighter) corroborates the fire reading. In-thread comment also flags the video predates 'Epic Fury' (Feb 28).

importance.lens_rationale: 952k impressions on emotionally charged war misinformation (atrocity falsely attributed to the US bombing disabled people); correcting wartime atrocity-misattribution has clear value for public understanding and animal/human-welfare-adjacent compassion exploitation.
